extraction.notes: IRT reports FFO and CFFO only; no AFFO, so affo fields are null. Reconciliation taken from the trailing-five-quarters table (printed p.11, seq 13); the Q4 three-month column matches the separate three-month statement (printed p.12). Recomputed FFO 79,443 and CFFO 78,910 tie. Diluted share count uses the weighted average shares and units (243,707,137), which reproduces $0.33 FFO and $0.32 CFFO per share. Zero-amount lines (prepayment gains, loss on extinguishment) are printed as dashes for Q4 2025 and are included as 0. 'Other loss' is classified as 'other' since it does not fit a named category. Recurring capex of $5.8 million is taken from the Capital Expenditures narrative (printed p.5) and is rounded as printed; it is stated for the 'total portfolio' with no explicit company-share qualifier.
